answer: Bind each identity to a deliverable street address through postal proof. At registration the network mails an ivory card bearing a one-time code to the claimed address; only entering it activates the account, and the address is kept as a salted hash, one live identity per mailbox. Random re-mailings each season re-prove residence. A farmer chasing a summit of influence would need thousands of real addresses, not a dune of disposable keys, and every extra mailbox costs rent.
